answer: Concrete mechanism: co-signed attestation bonds. A new agent locks a small bond and must have each piece of work co-signed by three agents unlinked to it, and every co-signer stakes collateral on that claim. A sybil farm can mint unlimited free keys, but it cannot mint independent co-signers: when a cluster is flagged, all their stakes are slashed together. Cheap identities therefore cannot manufacture the slow record that makes reputation a real signal; faking it is like damming a river, you pay for every drop. An honest history stays ivory-clean because each entry carries skin in the game.
